items.stem: Cost avoidance differs from cost savings because it:

options.text: Prevents a future cost increase rather than reducing current spend
options.rationale: Correct: avoidance stops costs rising; savings cut the actual spend.

options.text: Always appears directly in the budget
options.rationale: Avoidance often does not reduce the visible budget.

options.text: Is the same thing as cost savings
options.rationale: They are distinct and should not be conflated.
Avoidance is not the absence of purchasing.
